references.text: Aaron participated in making the golden calf that led to the Lord's anger against him
Moses confronts Aaron about his role in the sin of the golden calf
Moses interceded for the people when the Lord intended to destroy them
Moses interceded for Miriam when the Lord's anger struck her
Moses' intercession and the Lord's anger because of the people's sin
The psalm mentions the golden calf at Horeb and Moses who interceded
Jesus always lives to intercede, just as Moses interceded for Aaron
